title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
summary: OpenAI published its language-unsupervised milestone on June 11, 2018, reporting a task-agnostic language system that combined Transformer architecture with unsupervised generative pre-training followed by supervised fine-tuning. The associated technical report, Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training, was authored by Alec Radford, Karthik Narasimhan, Tim Salimans and Ilya Sutskever.
significance: A documented OpenAI language-model milestone demonstrating generative pre-training of a Transformer-based language model followed by task-specific fine-tuning across multiple natural-language-understanding benchmarks.

verification.note: June 11 2018 is the date of OpenAI's first-party milestone page. The associated first-party technical report verifies the title, authors and generative-pre-training plus fine-tuning method. This record deliberately does not use the retrospective label 'GPT-1' as the event title or assert a separate system-birth date because the contemporaneous 2018 first-party sources do not establish those claims with the same precision.
